description:
Fetch the GraphQL schema (SDL) for DAR/v2. REQUIRES DATAFORDELER_API_KEY.

The full schema is about 80,000 characters, mostly Danish field documentation. By default the doc comments are stripped, which leaves a compact list of types, fields and filter inputs. Pass filter to keep only type/input/enum blocks whose name contains the text (case-insensitive), e.g. filter: "DAR_Husnummer" (type, filter input, connection) or filter: "OperationFilterInput" (available operators). Set include_docs: true to keep the field definitions and legal references. Output is truncated at 60000 characters.

filter.description: Substring of a type name to keep, e.g. "DAR_Adresse".

include_docs.description: Keep the """doc comment""" blocks (Danish definitions, legal sources).

name: dar_get_graphql_schema
title: Get DAR GraphQL schema (API key)
